pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Oregon GPA
helpIntro: UO uses a 4.0 credit-weighted GPA: A=4.0, B=3.0, C=2.0, D=1.0, F=0.0, with plus/minus grades changing points by 0.3. Enter UO quarter credits and final grades to estimate your GPA.
helpNote: For the standard undergraduate UO institutional GPA. P/N, I, AU, W, X and Y are excluded. Since fall 2019, all graded UO repeat attempts count. Transfer grades do not enter the UO GPA. The calculator shows three decimals; UO officially truncates GPA to two decimals.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.0 points and a 4-credit B+ earns 13.2. Together, 29.2 ÷ 8 = 3.65.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.0; credits count in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from GPA computation.
gradeExplanations.N: No Pass is excluded from undergraduate GPA computation; law treatment differs.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.X: No grade reported; excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.Y: Historical no-basis-for-grade mark; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: UO course, standard undergraduate grading
specialTypes.note: Use the final posted UO grade and UO quarter credits.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer credit may apply to degree requirements, but grades from other institutions do not enter the UO institutional GPA.

specialTypes.name: Graduate or Law course/record
specialTypes.note: Graduate and law P/N treatment differs; use the appropriate official record and policy.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded UO attempt as a separate completed course. Repeat Impact is disabled because UO does not use grade replacement under the current policy.
